name: key_check
description: master_password.key_check = Fernet(key).encrypt('ciphermoth-key-check-v1:' || salt). A key is accepted only if it is the canonical 44-character base64url encoding (re-encoding the decoded bytes gives the same string) and the token decrypts to exactly that plaintext for the vault's current salt.

rejected_keys.note: unused low bits of the last character
right signing half, wrong encryption half
right encryption half, wrong signing half
